stories.title: China team brings X-ray vision to life with a compact high-speed ghost video cam
stories.summary: Chinese scientists have developed a new tabletop X-ray ghost imaging method that allows them to capture real-time “see-through” video of fast-moving objects. The team’s system could be used to capture dynamic objects such as rotating aircraft engines or biological movements like a beating heart. stories.title: Warehouses catch fire in Dagestan after UAV debris fall
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 24. A fire broke out in warehouse facilities in the Kumtorkalinsky District of Dagestan following the fall of UAV debris, with an infrastructure facility damaged, acting head of the Republic of Dagestan Fyodor Shchukin said on Max. "This morning falling UAV debris damaged an infrastructure facility in the Kumtorkalinsky District and caused a fire in warehouse premises. There were no casualties," he said, adding that emergency services are working at the scene.
